sentences.text: The Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act 2017 is a significant welfare scheme for women in India.
It aims to provide maternity benefits to women working in the organized sector.
The objective is to support women during pregnancy and after childbirth.
The scheme provides for paid maternity leave for a period of 26 weeks.
This benefit is applicable to women who have worked for at least 80 days in the 12 months preceding the expected date of delivery.
Women who adopt a child below the age of three months are also eligible for maternity benefits.
The application process involves notifying the employer about the pregnancy and submitting the required documents.
The maternity leave can be availed before or after the delivery as per the woman's choice.
The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Labour and Employment.
Employers are responsible for disbursing the maternity benefits to eligible employees.
The scheme also mandates the provision of crèche facilities for organizations with 50 or more employees.
This ensures that working mothers have access to childcare while they return to work.
